Description: Computes AP@0.5, AP@0.5:0.95, precision, recall, and F1 per model and per class against ground truth over configurable evaluation epochs
Auto-detects whether it sits downstream of a single inference model or a Gst-nvmodelmux primary/shadow pair
In Mode B, gates automatic promotion of a shadow model to primary using a minimum AP margin and configurable KPI thresholds (AP@0.5, precision, recall)
Auto-detects the ground-truth format (KITTI directory | NVSchema JSONL | COCO JSON | TAO JSON)
Supports per-model [model-<name>] config-file sections that override GT files, KPI thresholds, and promotion margins
